CRITICAL BUGS: (a) /profile, /my-events, /admin/analytics OVERFLOW at 390px (right=473–495 vs innerWidth=390) driven by a header 'ml-auto flex items-center gap-2' div and, on /my-events, an untruncated public-page-link <a>; (b) 'Newsletter' label is MISSING on /profile — task requires the standalone label 'Newsletter' (was 'Monthly newsletter') but neither string is present anywhere on the page; (c) clicking start-identity-btn does NOT surface a friendly toast containing 'Stripe Identity' — backend raises HTTPException 502 on stripe error, Cloudflare replaces the 502 body with its own HTML error page, so the toast literally shows 'The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare…'. Task expects 409; identity_router.py:58 must return 409 (not 502) with a JSON detail. (d) Boat Pro detail route missing: pro-card-<id> cards only link to /u/<handle> (sailor-profile page) — no /directory/<id> or /pros/<id> route with start-full-review-btn was found in the DOM. Could not verify 'Write a review' flow / MutualReviewForm 5-param rating / review-params-<id> breakdown on a real Boat Pro detail page. (e) Hero bottom edge vs wave color could not be verified as equal to #17324a — .smn-hero uses transparent bg + radial-gradient overlays and the wave svg path uses CSS fill (getAttribute returned null); needs a pixel screenshot comparison or explicit fill='#17324a' on the wave.

critical.issue: Returns HTTPException(status_code=502) on Stripe error; Cloudflare intercepts 5xx responses and replaces the JSON body with its own HTML 502 error page, so the frontend toast shows Cloudflare boilerplate instead of the intended 'Stripe Identity isn't enabled for this account yet' message. Change to 409 (per task spec) or 400/503; task explicitly requires 409.

ui_bugs.issue: 'ml-auto flex items-center gap-2' div overflows at 390px viewport (right=473) — needs flex-wrap or shrink. On /my-events the [data-testid="public-page-link"] <a> is a long unbreakable URL (width=462) that pushes to right=495; use break-all/truncate.

Required label 'Newsletter' is missing. Neither 'Newsletter' nor 'Monthly newsletter' appears anywhere in the DOM on /profile; the newsletter opt-in row itself is either missing or its label was renamed unexpectedly.

start-identity-btn click surfaces the raw Cloudflare 502 HTML body as the toast message ('The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare…'). Toast handler must (i) tolerate non-JSON error bodies and (ii) show a friendly 'Stripe Identity isn't enabled yet' string when response is not-ok, regardless of status code.

Pro cards on /directory link to /u/<handle> (sailor-profile page) only. No route to a boat-pro detail page with [data-testid="start-full-review-btn"] was found. Could not verify 'Write a review' flow, MutualReviewForm 5-param 0-star initial state, review-submit-btn disabled-until-all-rated, or review-params-<id> breakdown.

Could not verify hero bottom edge equals wave fill #17324a. .smn-hero has transparent background-color plus radial-gradient overlays; wave svg path uses CSS-set fill (getAttribute returned null). Screenshot on /contact shows a subtle lighter band between hero body and wave curve. Recommend either setting an explicit --smn-hero-bottom css var of #17324a on the last gradient stop AND fill='#17324a' on the wave path, or add a solid backgroundColor: #17324a on .smn-hero.

integration_issues.issue: Backend 502 + Cloudflare interception breaks the intended friendly-error flow end-to-end; user sees Cloudflare error text with no mention of Stripe Identity.

issues: Horizontal scrollbar due to header action group and long public URL — visible sideways scroll on real phones

action_items: identity_router.py:58 — replace HTTPException(status_code=502, ...) with 409 (or 503) so Cloudflare doesn't rewrite the body; keep detail string mentioning 'Stripe Identity'.

IdentityVerification.jsx / api error helper — when server returns a non-JSON body (Cloudflare 5xx), fall back to a static 'Stripe Identity isn't enabled yet — try again later.' toast instead of dumping response.text.
Add the standalone 'Newsletter' label to Profile.jsx (previously 'Monthly newsletter').
Header/user-menu on /profile /my-events /admin: add flex-wrap / min-w-0 / truncate to the 'ml-auto flex items-center gap-2' row so it doesn't exceed 390px.
/my-events public-page-link: add break-all (or truncate + copy button) so the long URL wraps.
Add a Boat Pro detail route (e.g. /directory/:proId) with [data-testid="start-full-review-btn"] and the MutualReviewForm; pro cards on /directory should link there, not to /u/<handle>.
Set .smn-hero bottom pixel to #17324a explicitly (solid backgroundColor or last radial-gradient stop) AND set the following wave svg path fill='#17324a' so the band disappears.
critical_code_review_comments: identity_router.py maps every Stripe failure (including 'Identity not enabled') to HTTP 502. 502 is a gateway status and gets rewritten by Cloudflare; use 4xx for user-actionable errors so the JSON detail survives.

The frontend seems to display raw response text on identity failure — any 5xx from any endpoint will produce an unrecognisable Cloudflare-branded toast. Consider a shared apiFetch helper that (a) tries JSON first, (b) falls back to a route-specific fallback message, never raw HTML.

Directory pro cards link to /u/<handle> which is a generic user-profile route; the reviewable Boat Pro object apparently doesn't have its own detail page. This makes the review flow uncrawlable and untestable.

hub_router.PUSH_KINDS default = True in the merged reply — a client sending {preferences:{}} on save wipes stored per-kind opt-outs; consider merging cleaned onto existing prefs rather than replacing (u.get('push_preferences') |= cleaned).

rca_of_the_issue: Identity friendly-error: backend raises HTTPException(502) → Cloudflare's edge treats every 5xx from origin as a gateway failure and replaces the response body with its own HTML error page (verified via direct curl). The frontend then toasts that HTML text. Root fix is on the backend: switch to a 4xx status (409 per task, or 400/503). Mobile overflow: the header action row on authenticated pages uses `ml-auto flex items-center gap-2` without min-w-0 or flex-wrap, so notification bells + avatar + theme toggle + market picker together exceed 390px; on /my-events an untruncated public URL <a> also pushes wider than viewport. Newsletter label: the checkbox row that previously rendered 'Monthly newsletter' has been removed rather than renamed to 'Newsletter' — the required label is absent.
